dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Faka NCCL ukusuka NVIDIA indawo yoMakhi. NCCL isetyenziselwa multi-GPU unxibelelwano oluhlangeneyo.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Faka NCCL usebenzisa NVIDIA indawo yokugcina ipakethe. KwiDebian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Bona i NVIDIA NCCL isikhokelo sokufakela kwi-distro yakho.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Faka cuDNN ukusuka NVIDIA indawo yoPhuhlisi kwaye ubeke iiDLL ecaleni kwesicelo okanye kwi-System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Faka cuDNN usebenzisa NVIDIA indawo yokugcina ipakethe okanye ukhuphele itarball kwaye ukhuphele iilibs ku /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Faka i Vulkan Ixesha lokuqalisa ukusuka LunarG. Umqhubi wakho we-GPU usenokuba sele eyifakile — hlaziya GPU umqhubi wakho kuqala.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Faka Vulkan umlayishi: ku-Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. KwiArch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. Kwi RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
